In the bitter northern winds, her blue hair dances wildly, blazing like fire against the pale sky. "Death by fire!" ◆ Express Renovation Escapade ◆
The Express has received a major update! The Trailblazer's room now features a display area and a gaming area, where you can arrange various souvenirs obtained during your journey and easily enjoy multiplayer gameplay. A Co-op Party Car has also been added to the Express. Go visit other Trailblazers and find the creations hiding in the Car!

◆ Unlock Criteria ◆
● Reach Trailblaze Level <unbreak>21</unbreak> and complete the Mission "Express Renovation Escapade" to unlock Co-op visits in the Party Car, as well as the creation capture gameplay.

◆ Trailblazer's Room Update Details ◆
● Added 3 new display areas to the room, where you can showcase Battle Record Medals, Souvenirs, and Journey Photos.
● Participate in the periodically updated permanent Challenges gameplay to obtain corresponding Battle Record Medals.
● Participate in in-game events and other gameplay to obtain Souvenirs.
● Complete Trailblaze Missions to obtain Journey Photos.
● The Trailblazer Profile display interface has been upgraded. The background will now be updated to the Trailblazer's Room display area.
● Added a Gaming Zone where you can play unlocked co-op game modes, such as "Seal Slammers."

◆ "Co-Op Party Car" Function ◆
● You can visit other Trailblazers' Party Cars.
● You can visit them even if the other party is offline.
● Up to 3 visitors can enter a Party Car at the same time.
● Trailblazers can meet, chat, and interact with visitors inside the Party Car.
● Trailblazers can manage visit permissions for their Party Car in "Settings" - "Social".

◆ "Meow-nificent New Journey" Gameplay Details ◆
● The Creation Meow Box refreshes once a week, resetting every Monday at <unbreak>04</unbreak>:<unbreak>00</unbreak> (server time). Opening the box will spawn 3 random creations that will then hide inside the Party Car.
● Trailblazers can catch one creation at each hiding spot. Creations at each spot can be caught repeatedly by different visitors.
● There are multiple hiding spots inside the Party Car. When hiding, a creation will leave its tail exposed. Dark and light-colored creations have different tail colors. When Trailblazers approach them, the creations will meow.
● Trailblazers can catch creations in their own Party Car or head to other Trailblazers' Party Cars in co-op to catch them. You can obtain a maximum of 9 creations per week.
● Trailblazers can place the creations they've obtained inside the Party Car. Catching duplicate creations will unlock more placement options.
● There is a small daily chance for the mysterious creation "Akivimeow" to appear. Interacting with "Akivimeow" a certain number of times will grant a mysterious gift.
